brief:
Residents of Masafer Yatta in the occupied West Bank have taken refuge in ancient caves after Israeli authorities demolished their homes, Al Jazeera English reported. The displacement has forced families to adapt to underground living conditions in the area.

The caves now serve as makeshift shelters for Palestinians who lost their residences in the demolitions. Masafer Yatta, located in the southern West Bank, has long been a flashpoint over settlement expansion and home demolition orders.
dek: Palestinians displaced in the occupied West Bank's Masafer Yatta area have been forced to live in underground caves.
title: Palestinians shelter in caves after Israel demolishes West Bank homes
